column1: # Extra checks shared by the mod (embedded in the DLL) and the APWorld (tools/gen_apworld_data.py).
# obtain: key = item prefab, sent when it enters your inventory (picked up or crafted)
# kill: key = trophy prefab the creature drops, sent when you kill one
# skill: key = SkillType:level, sent when the skill reaches that level
# discover: key = location prefab name prefix, sent when you first reach one
# build: key = piece prefab, sent when you place one
# eat: key = food prefab, sent when you eat it
# catch: key = fish prefab, sent when it enters your inventory
# tame: key = creature prefab, sent when one is tamed near you
# buy: key = item prefab, sent when you buy it from a trader
# explore: key = percent of the world map you have explored
# comfort: key = comfort level, sent when your comfort (what the Rested effect shows) reaches it
# read: key = rune stone location prefab, sent when you read a rune stone there
# vegvisir: key = the boss location a Vegvisir reveals, sent when you read one
# plant: key = sapling piece prefab, sent when you plant one (with the Cultivator)
# loot: key = treasure chest prefab, sent when you open one
# brew: key = mead prefab, sent when you tap it from a Fermenter
# raid: key = random event name, sent when that raid ends with you alive in it
